objective: Independent QA and security review of Egg Garden v0.4 (GARDEN-028 to GARDEN-031) against decision 0015 and GDD section V, with the trade safety rules tried from a second client and the evidence for the v0.4 checkpoint.
acceptance_criteria: docs/qa/garden-v04-review.md exists in the garden-v03-review.md format: scope, tool runs, severity table, verdict, findings labelled Computed, Read or Director

Trade safety tried, not read: a non-friend cannot propose; a trade with the lower side under 50% is refused with the kind message; favourites cannot be picked; cancel works at every step; a fourth trade in a day is refused; walking apart cancels; a traded creature adds no Index entry and no XP; undo returns both creatures to the right slots and refuses after 10 minutes or when the creature was released; the ledger holds every trade; a flush failure forced on one side (fake store) heals at the next load with no duplicate and no loss (Computed, two clients, build stamp)

Charms, weathers and the Moth in GardenConfig equal decision 0015 (Computed, by script); 49 egg-weather pairs are under 60% by the spec's bound; every existing seeded hatch spec still passes unchanged; a v2 save loads unchanged plus the v3 defaults

Names: a refused character set, a filtered word shown as the filter returns it, the cooldown and rename limit, no name in an announce payload or on the board (Read and tried); no client computes fairness or writes a name; followers have no collision or query; nothing new is sent by the client beyond the listed actions
The checkpoint doc lists the evidence: CI run link, test counts, build stamp, the two-client trade recording, the weather and Stormy screenshots, the follower, a named tag, the eight eggs
verification: A04 reads the review; CI run link and test-results.json attached as evidence
notes: Reviewer must not have written GARDEN-028, 029, 030 or 031 (CLAUDE.md rule 2). The trade write order (ledger first, two applies in one step, heal at load) is the item to attack hardest: try a crash between the two flushes with the fake DataStore. Studio facts count only with the build stamp (rule 13).
